tool_args.rationale: The five pilot observations show positive gain only at H=0.16–0.48. Measuring near H=20 directly tests the expected sign reversal and constrains the slow response near the H=23 forecast target.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, the slow response mainly constrains the ratio of its amplitude to its time constant. Different values can fit the pilot yet predict different reversal magnitudes at H=23.
Finer sampling does not directly test the late reversal; the long-horizon probe costs only 0.5 more.
All pilot rows have s_grad=0, so they cannot identify a sink coupling.
